summary: Both backend and frontend were tested for the shared gallery->crop->normalize->multipart flow regression. Settings and Create upload entry points are visible and working in mobile web preview; backend upload/auth/profile chain passes targeted pytest checks. Native Android gallery/crop (content:// on release devices) cannot be executed in Playwright web preview and remains pending device validation.

minor.endpoint: Push integration (/api/register-push and notification push trigger path)
minor.issue: Backend logs show repeated 401 from Emergent push trigger; notifications persist but push delivery integration is degraded in this environment.

integration_issues.flow: Android native gallery + crop + content:// normalization
integration_issues.issue: Not testable in web preview. Playwright cannot access real Android gallery picker/cropper runtime.

action_items: Run physical Android release-device validation for content:// crop outputs to confirm ImageManipulator always returns usable cache file:// JPEG.
Confirm native multipart payload on Android release via device/network inspection (uri starts with file://, JPEG mime, generated .jpg filename, and no manual multipart Content-Type header).
Investigate push provider credential/config to resolve repeated 401 push trigger errors in backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: Both Settings and Create flows use the same helper: pickCroppedImage from /app/frontend/src/utils/image-upload.ts.
Helper normalizes with Expo ImageManipulator to JPEG and verifies file existence/size via FileSystem.getInfoAsync before returning upload metadata.
uploadImage native path appends multipart file object { uri, name, type } and intentionally avoids manually setting multipart Content-Type headers.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (requested UI regressions passed; native Android gallery/crop runtime untestable in web preview)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary upload objects during /api/uploads tests; no new user/question created. Admin avatar was restored to original value in test cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Do not recreate users/questions. Continue with device-level Android release validation only for real gallery/crop/content:// behavior and multipart wire payload verification.
rca_of_issue: No regression found in shared helper wiring or web UI entry points. Remaining risk is platform-specific: Android release crop can return content:// URI, which cannot be emulated in Playwright web runtime.
